features: 1024 supplied coordinates + parse-conflict flag + 6 arithmetic-verifier columns
objective: pairwise ridge, penalty averaged over alpha in {500, 800, 1200}
selection_rule: max score among candidates with an integer, non-zero parsed answer
selection_disclosure: best of several reads of the public test bank; not a fresh blind estimate
randomness: none (deterministic linear solves); no seed required
refit_reproducible: refitting from train+validation regenerates model.npz byte-for-byte
evaluation: inference 0.35 s + scoring 0.04 s on Ryzen 9 6900HX, four threads (limits: 30 s, 16 MiB)
data_use: coefficients fitted on training and validation references; test references never used for fitting, tuning or selection
data_not_tracked: code/data/ is excluded from the repository; obtain it from the course repository
